description: Quote the exact Gold price to edit an owned gallery video. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_generate_video_edit with the same inputs and quote_token.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio supported by the model, such as 16:9.

audio_id.description: Optional owned gallery reference audio UUID, where supported by the model.

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds, where supported by the model.

model.description: Enabled video model supporting video-edit; chargen_list_media_models can help choose a model. This never changes the operation.

prompt.description: The change to make to the video.

reference_image_ids.description: Owned reference image UUIDs, where supported. Reference-to-video needs at least one image, audio or video reference; model-specific source counts are validated by the media policy.

resolution.description: Resolution supported by the model, such as 720p.

swap_mode.description: OpenJutsu Object Swap only: Change (default) changes the target into what the prompt or the reference image describes; Background keeps the target and changes everything around it.

swap_target.description: OpenJutsu Object Swap only, and required there: the thing in the video to change, such as hair, jacket or car (a comma list is allowed). In Background mode, the thing to keep.

video_id.description: Owned gallery video UUID to edit, follow or add sound to.

name: chargen_quote_video_edit
title: Quote video edit
